notes.title: v1.0.3 Yet another hotfix
notes.notes:
- Balance adjustments to cleaning and ghost frogs
- Let sharks eat trilobites
- Adjust some sound effects
- Added a background to the achievements menu

notes.title: v1.0.1 Day one hotfix
notes.notes:
Bug fixes
- Dirty tank graphic no longer renders under pets
- Fixed localization of cards in your starting hand not updating
- Fixed missing Discord confirmation translation
- Changed a misleading achievement description
- Stopped pets dying after you've already won
- Fixed card getting stuck in hover state if the game paused while hovering
- Fixed minigame not unlocking if you alt-f4 the first time playing it
- Made collection minigame less frustrating by always picking the right coin when there's overlap
